tr.literal_en: To roll up your trousers before seeing the stream

en.idiom: Don't count your chickens before they hatch

meaning: Bir şey kesinleşmeden ona güvenip harekete geçmek.
example_en: You haven't got the job yet. Don't count your chickens before they hatch!
